ownerThemes.theme: An owner who chose the Brother on price says it has handled several king and queen quilts and singles out the knee lift and thread cutter; she does not do detailed free motion.
In Juki versus Brother threads, Juki owners describe their machines as heavier and quieter, and note the mechanical Juki needs frequent oiling; the Brother is positioned as the value pick.
Beginner quilting groups frequently ask PQ1600S or TL-2010Q, which shows the two are cross shopped directly.

editorial.verdict: The PQ1600S is the lowest cost route to 1,500 spm straight stitching with a knee lifter and a wide table. It competes on price with the Juki TL class and gives up the die cast body and dealer network in exchange.
editorial.whoFor: A piecer or table quilter who wants speed, a knee lifter and a big table for the least money, and does not need decorative stitches.
editorial.skipIf: You want one machine for garments and quilts (no zigzag or buttonhole), you want frame quilting with regulated stitches, or you value dealer service over online price.
editorial.keySpec: 8.7 x 5.7 in throat · 1,500 spm · straight stitch only · 7 feet and wide table included
